title: Age-related changes in cortical 1/f dynamics are linked to cardiac activity
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Reconstruct the simultaneously measured ECG time series from the original M/EEG recordings using the backward decoding task of Figure 3C,D. Retain MEG and EEG separately and all three source conditions: ECG components present, rejected and isolated. Higher reconstruction accuracy measures decoder performance under a fixed input condition, not better removal of cardiac artifacts or a stronger age association.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Reconstruct the simultaneously measured ECG time series from the original M/EEG recordings using the backward decoding task of Figure 3C,D. Retain MEG and EEG separately and all three source conditions: ECG components present, rejected and isolated. Higher reconstruction accuracy measures decoder performance under a fixed input condition, not better removal of cardiac artifacts or a stronger age association.

Source-paper comparison for Original Figure 3C,D held-out ECG reconstruction Pearson r, separately for MEG/EEG and the three source ICA conditions: Source reconstruction accuracy is Pearson r between predicted and measured ECG time series on the original test support: covariance divided by the product of standard deviations. Retain six modality-by-ICA-condition scores; zero-variance series must not receive an invented success score. Standardized EEG-versus-MEG contrasts and their significance are not decoder-accuracy baselines.
success_criteria: Authenticate the original 20-person simultaneous Salzburg cohort, recordings, condition-specific channels, preprocessing and four-fold nested partitions for Figure 3C,D.
Recover exact published reconstruction scores and execute an independently checked author baseline on the same source support before comparing a frozen candidate.
Retain both modalities and all three original ICA conditions under a predeclared comparison rule; improved performance on one easier condition cannot silently replace the source task.

Match and disclose the original ECG-informed ICA/preprocessing exposure. Do not supply final ECG targets directly as decoder inputs, alter the permitted lag window, or claim a prospective causal predictor from the original acausal reconstruction.

Require a justified effect and valid paired subject-level uncertainty under fixed access and resource budgets; tighter posterior reconstruction or stronger modality/age significance cannot count as success.

Label new participant splits, new cohorts, changed cleaning targets or a different artifact-removal ground truth as extensions. An admitted win here concerns the source ECG reconstruction task, not improved removal of cardiac activity or a whole-paper physiological conclusion.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.
